invariants.rationale: The method casts key and calls methods on it, so key must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
Partition or bucket indices (such as those returned from a bucket list) are typically non-negative.
getLeft() is used to access the partition path and record key, so it must not be null before use.
getRight() is used and further has isPresent() invoked on it, so must not be null.
If getRight().isPresent() is false, the last return value is targetBuckets.get(0).getKey().bucketNumber.
